source.name: ran.de, Was die Hauptsponsoren den 18 Klubs in der Saison 2026/27 bezahlen (Quelle: kicker.de)
source.quote: Borussia Mönchengladbach Hauptsponsor: Reuter Vertragslaufzeit: seit 2024, bis 2027 Summe: 8 Millionen Euro pro Jahr

note: Two-year deal from 2024 with option (now exercised) to 2027; reported ~EUR8m per year, plus success bonuses. The club's own announcement (borussia.de, 2026) says the partnership originally to 2026 was extended by option into 2027.
